decisive_spans.text: The biopsy results showed spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis and a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis with a peripheral mantle zone surrounding a central germinal center with cells that were CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative

response.rationale: The biopsy results strongly support Cutaneous Pseudolymphoma (D2) and contradict other candidates. The presence of a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate with a peripheral mantle zone surrounding a central germinal center with CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative cells is a key diagnostic feature for pseudolymphoma. While D10 (Discoid Lupus Erythematosus) has some supporting features, the biopsy findings are more specific to D2.
